boundaries.name: plonky2_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten builder/prover/verifier programs must be linked to actual plonky2 compilation, proving and verification; soundness of the embedded verify_proof gadget and of data.verify (verifyData/proveData callbacks) is not discharged.

boundaries.name: in_circuit_key_binding_elsewhere
boundaries.obligation: This file never connects the forwarded verifier-key limbs to its own key in-circuit; that binding is in withdrawal_step.rs (conditionally_connect_vd) and withdrawal_circuit.rs (add_proof_target_and_verify_cyclic) and must be audited there.

boundaries.name: build_reports_registered_count
boundaries.obligation: BuildReportsRegisteredCount: plonky2 build must report num_public_inputs equal to the registered wire count for the common-data equality theorem to bind the count.

boundaries.name: common_data_equality
boundaries.obligation: CommonCircuitData equality is modeled as capHeight/numPublicInputs plus an opaque fingerprint; the real comparison covers gates, selectors, FRI params and k_is.

boundaries.name: forwarded_step_semantics
boundaries.obligation: The meaning of the first 23 forwarded limbs (withdrawal hash chain, public state) and the correctness of the step proof are withdrawal_step.rs obligations; this file forwards them without inspection.

boundaries.name: field_representation
boundaries.obligation: Public-input limbs are Nat representatives; canonical Goldilocks encoding and hash-out equality are not modeled.

boundaries.name: rollup_gate_cross_reference
boundaries.obligation: rollupLimbGate pins RollupValue.verifyWithdrawalSet's 17-limb requirement locally; the Solidity/Lean rollup model is not imported, so the mismatch theorem is a count comparison only.

boundaries.name: fixtures
boundaries.obligation: The release-only unit test was read, not executed or translated.
